title: Refactored process launching logic for Chromium-based browsers (Brave…
body:
…, Chrome, Edge, etc.) to prevent crash loops by removing recursive calls.

Introduced conditional cloning of user profile directories into a sandboxed folder to ensure process isolation and repeatability.

Added fallback logic and cleanup handling to enhance reliability during repeated launches.

Enhanced InputHandler.cs to support high-DPI environments by introducing DPI-aware coordinate scaling.

Improved window target resolution using ChildWindowFromPoint traversal to ensure accurate mouse input routing.

Retained existing PostMessage dispatching for compatibility while improving precision in input delivery.
